1.text: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting Allāh.<sup foot_note="228030">1</sup> To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.

2.text: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

3.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.

4.text: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And Allāh is Knowing of that within the breasts.

5.text: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.

6.text: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allāh dispensed [with them]; and Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy.

7.text: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allāh, is easy."

8.text: So believe in Allāh and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

9.text: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation.<sup foot_note="228031">1</sup> And whoever believes in Allāh and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.

footnotes.228031: - "At-Taghābun" suggests having been outdone by others in the acquisition of something valued.  That Day, the disbelievers will suffer the loss of Paradise to the believers.

10.text: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.

11.text: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allāh. And whoever believes in Allāh - He will guide his heart. And Allāh is Knowing of all things.

12.text: And obey Allāh and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.

13.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

14.text: O you who have believed, indeed, among your spouses and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

15.text: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allāh has with Him a great reward.

16.text: So fear Allāh as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allāh]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.

17.text: If you loan Allāh a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allāh is [most] Appreciative<sup foot_note="228032">1</sup> and Forbearing,<sup foot_note="228033">2</sup>

footnotes.228032: Who gives much in return for little.

18.text: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
